coordinates: CAD world coordinates: +Z up; front is -Y. Explode offsets are illustrative, not an assembly-motion simulation.

parts.label: Base enclosure
parts.description: Low fixed enclosure with an integrated vertical front for five LEDs and an optional OLED. No lid or separate front panel. Drill the DC-jack hole after dry-fitting the actual converter and wiring.

parts.label: One-piece cradle
parts.description: Rigid floating cradle with integral spool ramps and fixed sides. Target spools are 50–100 mm wide and 160–220 mm in diameter. Align the reader-side flange with the tower. Keep the cradle clear of the fixed base.

parts.label: Load-cell spacer
parts.description: Solid spacer between the moving load-cell end and the cradle. Two load-cell screws clamp the spacer in place. Keep the load-cell flexing section clear.

parts.label: NFC tower
parts.description: Broad reader tower bonded to the keyed seat on the cradle. The front face stays beside the spool flange. The cavity behind it conceals the reader and its wire loop. Bond strength and NFC range require physical checks.

parts.label: NFC reader cassette
parts.description: Compact PN532 holder. Two nylon screws set its vertical position behind the tower face. Rotate the seated spool to bring its tag to the reader. Board dimensions and cable slack require checking.

parts.label: NFC rear cover
parts.description: Flat removable rear cover secured by two nylon screws. Remove it for reader adjustment and cable service. Keep it removable rather than gluing it closed.

parts.label: 5 kg load cell
parts.description: Nominal 80 × 12.7 × 12.7 mm bar cell. One end bolts to the base, the other supports the spacer and floating cradle. Verify the delivered thread sizes, screw depth and calibration.

parts.label: ESP32-S3 controller
parts.description: N16R8 development-board envelope with approximate component and header-wire space. Check actual board fit and BOOT-button access before securing it.

parts.label: HX711 amplifier
parts.description: Nominal HX711 board and component envelopes. Keep load-cell wiring clear of the moving cradle. The electrical connections are not modeled.

parts.label: PN532 NFC reader
parts.description: Approximate PN532 board held in the reader cassette. Verify the actual board, connector clearance, antenna orientation and read range through the printed tower face.

parts.label: Five addressable LEDs
parts.description: 5 V addressable strip with five LEDs at 16.67 mm centres, equivalent to 60 LEDs/metre. Strip width, coating and actual package dimensions remain provisional.

parts.label: Fixed load-cell screws
parts.description: Two metal M5 load-cell screws at the fixed end. Thread size and usable engagement depend on the received cell; consult the current parts list before buying.

parts.label: Moving load-cell screws
parts.description: Two metal M4 load-cell screws clamp the cradle and spacer to the moving end. Remove these to lift the cradle for service. Verify the received cell thread depth.

parts.label: Four adjustable stops
parts.description: Four M3 screws with locking nuts below the cradle. Set and verify clearance after assembly and calibration. The overload behavior has not been physically tested.

parts.label: Two reader clamps
parts.description: Two nylon M3 screws with nuts clamp the reader cassette at the selected height. Nylon keeps these fasteners nonmetallic near the antenna. Clamp strength remains untested.

parts.label: Two rear-cover screws
parts.description: Two nylon M3 screws with nuts secure the removable rear cover. These screws provide access to the reader and hidden cable cavity.

parts.label: Four rubber feet
parts.description: Adhesive rubber feet under the fixed base. Reference geometry only; check the actual foot thickness and grip.

parts.label: Reference spool
parts.description: Nominal upright spool reference. The fixed cradle targets 50–100 mm widths and 160–220 mm diameters. Fit across that range still requires physical verification.

parts.label: Reader wire loop
parts.description: Nominal wire space hidden behind the tower front. Allow loose wire for vertical reader adjustment. This reference does not simulate wire stiffness, bend radius or full-travel movement.

parts.label: Cable into the base
parts.description: Nominal free cable tail into the fixed electronics base. Keep the loop loose and clear of the weighing gap. Cable forces and their effect on scale zero require a physical test.
